veranderings.rede: A gate's hinges 'kraak' in idiomatic Afrikaans; 'kras' is a harsh scraping or a crow's call and reads oddly for a gate.
The pronoun 'enigeen' is written as one word (AWS/HAT).

veranderings.blok: Wat diep in jou oor breek
veranderings.voor: stuur die boodskap na jou brein toe
veranderings.na: stuur 'n boodskap na jou brein toe
veranderings.rede: No message has been mentioned before, so the definite article points back to nothing; the indefinite article fits.

veranderings.blok: Hoe jy weet 'n klank is te hard
veranderings.rede: 'n Armlengte' is the natural Afrikaans compound; 'n arm se lengte' is a word-for-word rendering of English.

veranderings.blok: Hoe jy jou ore veilig hou
veranderings.rede: 'Daar' used for 'in that situation' is wooden here; 'Dan help dit as' is the natural conditional and keeps the meaning.

veranderings.voor: Wanneer iets vir altyd so bly en nooit weer verander nie.
veranderings.na: Wat vir altyd so bly en nooit weer verander nie.
veranderings.rede: 'Permanent' is an adjective, so a 'wat ...' definition fits the headword better than a 'wanneer ...' clause; meaning unchanged.
